description: VoiceOver announces the reason why a lifecycle command is disabled, not just that it is disabled, enabling screen reader users to understand the blocked state.
assertions: VoiceOver reads accessibilityLabel for CancelRun menu item
VoiceOver reads reason for disabled state (e.g. 'No lifecycle window active')
disabled reason provided via accessibilityHint or accessibilityValue
announcement does not just say 'dimmed' without context
